# Portfolio 2: Performance analysis (generated by run_portfolio2.py)

Dataset: 40,000 registrations, 2,000 students. Median of 30 runs, SQLite 3.45.1.

| Experiment | Before (ms) | After (ms) | Speed-up |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| O1 class list for one offering | 0.694 | 0.143 | 4.9x |
| O2 active students in a programme/intake | 0.099 | 0.008 | 12.3x |
| O3 failing results (score < 40) | 1.937 | 0.207 | 9.3x |
| O4 results for one semester via offering | 0.309 | 0.329 | 0.9x |

Query rewrite (correlated subquery vs LEFT JOIN + GROUP BY): 0.39 ms vs 0.76 ms; identical results: True.
